thread:
Juan: starting the migration for orders.address_line change now — gentle backfill running on replica-02. tagging release notes: orders-db-v3.2.1
Samira: noted. I'll watch pg_stat_activity and the deploybot channel.
DeployBot: MIGRATION STARTED orders_db.orders_address_v3 on node replica-02 (pid=9212)
Oliver: I'm seeing increased lock waits on replica-02, top query is the backfill UPDATE.
Maria: can we throttle the backfill job? which job id?
Juan: job id 3421 (background_backfill). currently chunk_size=10k. lowering to 1k now.
Samira: please run the throttle patch: `kubectl exec -c backfill jobs/backfill-3421 -- patch -p '{"chunk_size":1000}'`
Oliver: doing it. patch applied. throughput dropped but latency on primary still climbing.
Juan: hmm, primary is getting replication apply backlog; replica-02 falling behind. maybe the UPDATEs are spilling to primary due to cascade triggers.
Maria: I remember there was a trigger rewrite on orders that's new. Could be firing extra writes.
sre-bot: ALERT: replica-02 replication_lag > 120s.
DeployBot: CANARY PAUSED for orders_db.orders_address_v3 due to replication lag.
Samira: proposal: pause backfill, flip the release flag so app reads old column, and continue with non-blocking schema change (add new column + populate asynchronously).
Oliver: agree. flip flag name `orders.address_use_v3` to false in feature-flag store, then re-run backfill later.
Juan: objection: how do we ensure read path stays consistent? there's a fast-path in checkout that expects v3 address format for a small percentage of traffic.
Maria: we can add a compatibility shim in checkout that falls back to legacy parsing when flag=false. I can ship a tiny patch and roll to 10% first.
Samira: timeline: pause backfill now, flip flag, roll shim to 10% -> monitor 15m -> roll to 100% -> resume migration at lower rate.
Juan: OK. executing pause: `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/ops/migrations/3421/pause`
DeployBot: BACKFILL 3421 PAUSED by Juan at 1744129889
Oliver: flag flip done: `ffctl set orders.address_use_v3 false --env=prod`
Maria: rolling shim to 10% now (traffic-split). patch:
```
--- a/services/checkout/parse_address.py
+++ b/services/checkout/parse_address.py
@@
-if use_v3:
-  return parse_v3(addr)
+if feature_flags.get('orders.address_use_v3'):
+  return parse_v3(addr)
+else:
+  return legacy_parse(addr)
```

Maria: rollout 10% done. keeping watch on checkout errors and latency.
Samira: monitor checklist: errors (SLOs), payment failures, and cart abandonment. ping when safe to proceed.
Oliver: replication lag back down to 10s. CPU on replica-02 at 45%. good.
Juan: after 15m, no uptick in checkout failures.
Maria: rolling shim to 100% now.
DeployBot: ROLLOUT 100% complete for checkout-shim (release checkout-addr-compat v1.1)
Samira: re-run the backfill but set `chunk_size=500` and `sleep_ms=50` between chunks. also set a hard throttle window: run only in change window 02:00-06:00 UTC.
Juan: scheduling job patch: `jobsctl update 3421 --chunk-size=500 --sleep-ms=50 --window='02:00-06:00'`
DeployBot: BACKFILL 3421 SCHEDULED with new params by Juan at 1744129960
Oliver: also adding safeguard: if replication_lag > 30s, job auto-pauses.
Maria: and adding a postbackfill smoke test to release notes and to the release checklist.
Samira: release notes draft: "orders-db-v3.2.1: Adds structured address column. Backfill runs in low-traffic window with adaptive throttling and auto-pause on replication lag. Compatibility shim shipped to avoid checkout regressions."
Juan: should we pin the DB migration tool version for the weekend run? last time a minor change to migrator caused a semantics change.
Oliver: yes, pin to migrator v2.5.3 for the scheduled window. `migrator_image: infra/migrator:v2.5.3`
Samira: adding that to the release note and to the deploybot job config.
DeployBot: JOB CONFIG UPDATED: migrator_image=infra/migrator:v2.5.3 (applied at 1744129980)
Juan: final check: rollback plan in release notes: if we see >0.5% payment failures or replication_lag > 60s for more than 5m, abort backfill and revert flag to true, then run safe rollback tasks.
Maria: spelled out steps added to notes. pushing release notes now.
Oliver: thanks everyone. I'll keep an eye through the window and we'll reconvene if deploybot trips the auto-pause. :thumbsup:
Samira: nice coordination. props for quick flag roll. :party_parrot:
DeployBot: THREAD CLOSED (pause/rollback safety hooks active).
